sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Semiconductor Crisis is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Yesterday, while I was mounting a red dot on an M4, I noticed someone on one of my monitors who looked like he was praying. He had covered the walls with strange symbols, drawn a circle on the floor, and started placing weapons inside it. Oddly enough... it made sense to me. That's how religion works, isn't it? You offer your gods the things that matter most to you. Seems those cultists think the same way. You've probably run into them already. Anyway, back to business. I've got enough electrical capacity for now. Go find me some more graphics cards and cooling fans."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find the item in raid: 1 Graphics card
- Hand over the item
- Find the item in raid: 8 CPU fan
- Hand over the items

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Tech manual
- Unlocks barter of Kalashnikov AK-104 7.62x39 assault rifle (variant T-SAW) at Mechanic LL3
"Ah, you've returned. I'll try to assemble them till nightfall, thanks. I know, it's really hard to find such electronics during these hard times, but I never doubted you."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Graphics card | 1 | Handover item | Yes | Can be crafted in the Hideout (Intelligence Center lv. 3). |
| CPU fan | 8 | Handover item | Yes | |

- CPU fans can be found inside of electronics stores, but are most commonly found inside of PC blocks.

- Graphics cards can be found:
  - In PC blocks
  - In Sport bags
  - Inside Buried barrel cache
  - Inside Ground cache
